description: This file defines the HTML tokenization logic, including token types, token structures, and the Tokenizer class for parsing HTML streams. It handles different token types such as start tags, end tags, comments, doctype, and script content, with methods for reading and processing HTML tokens.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Represents an HTML token with type, data, data atom, and attributes.

classes.name: Tokenizer
classes.description: Provides a stream-based HTML tokenizer capable of parsing HTML input into tokens.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the TokenType.

methods.name: tagString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a tag token's data and attributes.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Token.

methods.name: Raw
methods.description: Returns the raw bytes of the current token.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Returns the unescaped text of a text, comment, or doctype token.

methods.name: TagName
methods.description: Returns the lower-cased name of a tag token and whether it has attributes.

methods.name: TagAttr
methods.description: Returns the lower-cased key and unescaped value of the next attribute.

methods.name: Token
methods.description: Returns the current token with all its data and attributes.

methods.name: SetMaxBuf
methods.description: Sets a limit on the amount of data buffered during tokenization.

methods.name: AllowCDATA
methods.description: Configures whether CDATA sections are recognized.

methods.name: NextIsNotRawText
methods.description: Instructs the tokenizer that the next token should not be raw text.

methods.name: Err
methods.description: Returns the error associated with the most recent error token.

methods.name: readByte
methods.description: Reads the next byte from the input stream, buffering as needed.

methods.name: Buffered
methods.description: Returns buffered data not yet tokenized.

methods.name: readAtLeastOneByte
methods.description: Reads at least one byte from the underlying reader, handling retries.

methods.name: skipWhiteSpace
methods.description: Skips whitespace characters in the input stream.

methods.name: readRawOrRCDATA
methods.description: Reads raw or RCDATA sections until the closing tag.

methods.name: readRawEndTag
methods.description: Attempts to read an end tag matching the current raw tag.

methods.name: readScript
methods.description: Reads script content until the closing </script> tag.

methods.name: readComment
methods.description: Reads an HTML comment token.

methods.name: calculateAbruptCommentDataEnd
methods.description: Calculates the end position of an abrupt comment.

methods.name: hasSuffix
methods.description: Checks if a byte slice has a specific suffix.

methods.name: readUntilCloseAngle
methods.description: Reads input until the next '>' character.

methods.name: readMarkupDeclaration
methods.description: Reads markup declarations starting with '<!'.

methods.name: readDoctype
methods.description: Attempts to read a doctype declaration.

methods.name: readCDATA
methods.description: Attempts to read a CDATA section.

methods.name: startTagIn
methods.description: Checks if the start tag matches any in a list, case-insensitive.

methods.name: readStartTag
methods.description: Reads a start tag token.

methods.name: readTag
methods.description: Reads a tag and its attributes.

methods.name: readTagName
methods.description: Reads the tag name.

methods.name: readTagAttrKey
methods.description: Reads an attribute key.

methods.name: readTagAttrVal
methods.description: Reads an attribute value.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Scans the next token and returns its type.
